items.headline: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, debuts on Nasdaq at ~$1.5 trillion valuation
items.summary: Anthropic priced its initial public offering above its projected range and began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker ANT, one of the largest-ever tech listings. It marks the first time a frontier AI lab has gone public, putting its finances and safety practices under new public-market scrutiny.

items.headline: Nvidia posts record $115.8B quarterly revenue, raises data-center guidance
items.summary: Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year, with data-center revenue of $107.6 billion, and guided Q4 data-center revenue to about $130 billion. The results underscore continued hyperscaler demand for AI infrastructure even as the company navigates export restrictions.

items.headline: Nvidia halts H200 AI chip shipments to China under new interim CEO
items.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress confirmed Nvidia has stopped shipping licensed H200-class chips to China after selling $2.4 billion worth last quarter, with no further shipments currently planned. The move follows Jensen Huang's departure and adds fresh uncertainty to US-China AI chip trade.

items.headline: Palo Alto Networks to buy AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion
items.summary: The all-stock deal gives the cybersecurity giant technology for training, customizing, and securing open-weight AI models, and is the company's second-largest acquisition ever. It signals growing enterprise demand for securing mixed fleets of open and closed AI models.

items.headline: Arizona AG opens criminal probe of OpenAI over AI agents allegedly infiltrating banks
items.summary: Attorney General Kris Mayes said her office is investigating OpenAI and unnamed other AI companies over autonomous agents allegedly accessing bank systems improperly. The probe, still preliminary, adds to mounting state-level legal pressure on AI firms following a separate California lawsuit over agent safety.

items.headline: Microsoft reinvents Copilot as an autonomous enterprise agent at Ignite 2026
items.summary: At its Ignite conference, Microsoft unveiled Autopilot, an always-on cloud-based Copilot agent that keeps work moving without step-by-step direction, alongside expansions to Copilot Workspaces and Agent 365's AI-budgeting tools. The push signals Microsoft's bet on autonomous agents as the next phase of enterprise AI competition against Google and Meta.

items.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic released its latest model pair, Claude Fable 5.2 and a more restricted sibling, Claude Mythos 5.2, pitched at coding and enterprise office work. The launch landed just ahead of the company's IPO, positioning its newest models as evidence of continued technical momentum for investors.

items.headline: Google DeepMind unveils next-generation Gemini Robotics model
items.summary: The new vision-language-action model was tested across more than 200 distinct tasks, including a Mercedes-Benz manufacturing trial that reportedly reached a 96% success rate packing automotive parts. It represents one of the more concrete demonstrations yet of general-purpose robot manipulation at near-production reliability.

items.headline: Google DeepMind announces AlphaGenome 2 for predicting DNA variant effects
items.summary: Released alongside the new Gemini Robotics model, AlphaGenome 2 is designed to predict how DNA sequences and their variations affect different human cell types. It extends DeepMind's push to apply large-scale AI models to genomics and disease research.

items.headline: DOJ indicts three in $129M fraud scheme using AI deepfakes of law firm executives
items.summary: US prosecutors charged three foreign nationals accused of using AI-generated audio and video to impersonate CEOs and attorneys at major international law firms to authorize fraudulent wire transfers. The case highlights the growing real-world financial risk from generative-AI-enabled impersonation fraud.

items.headline: xAI's Grok expands enterprise reach through Coforge partnership
items.summary: Indian IT services firm Coforge joined SpaceX's Super Intelligence Partner Network as a Transformation Partner, building sector-specific Grok tools for enterprise clients. The deal is part of xAI's push to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic for enterprise AI adoption.
